name: pub
description: pub.dev is the official registry for Dart and Flutter packages. This CLI searches packages and reads package metadata, versions, scores, metrics, docs status, publishers, topics and the atom feeds through pub.dev's public JSON API.

commands.name: search-packages
commands.summary: Search pub.dev packages by keyword and/or qualifiers (topic:, platform:, sdk:, dependency:, publisher:, is:, license:, has:, updated:), with sort and pagination.

params.name: q
params.description: Search query. Free text plus optional qualifiers, e.g. 'http', 'topic:http platform:web', 'dependency:dio', 'publisher:dart.dev', 'is:flutter-favorite'. Prefix a qualifier with '-' to negate it.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order. Omit for the default ranking.

params.name: page
params.description: Result page number, starting at 1. Each page has 10 packages.

commands.name: get-package
commands.summary: Get a package's latest version: version number, pubspec (description, dependencies, SDK constraint, repository), archive URL and publish date.

commands.name: list-package-versions
commands.summary: List all published versions of a package, oldest first, with publish date and archive URL.

commands.name: get-package-version
commands.summary: Get the pubspec, archive URL/sha256 and publish date of one specific package version.

commands.name: get-package-score
commands.summary: Get a package's pub points (granted/max), like count, 30-day downloads and tags (sdk, platform, publisher, license, etc.).

commands.name: get-package-metrics
commands.summary: Get the full analysis scorecard for a package: score, pana report sections, licenses, repository verification, all dependencies and weekly download history.

commands.name: get-package-likes
commands.summary: Get the number of likes for a package.

commands.name: get-package-publisher
commands.summary: Get the verified publisher ID that owns a package (null if it has no publisher).

commands.name: get-package-options
commands.summary: Check whether a package is discontinued or unlisted, and which package replaces it.

commands.name: get-package-docs-status
commands.summary: List a package's versions with their API documentation (dartdoc) build status and availability.

commands.name: get-package-feed
commands.summary: Get the Atom feed of a package's recently published versions, including changelog excerpts.

commands.name: get-publisher
commands.summary: Get a verified publisher's description, website URL and contact email.

params.name: publisher
params.description: Publisher ID (a verified domain), e.g. dart.dev

commands.name: list-publisher-packages
commands.summary: List packages owned by a publisher, with likes, pub points, downloads, latest version and description (scraped from the publisher's packages page).

params.name: publisher
params.description: Publisher ID (a verified domain), e.g. dart.dev

commands.name: list-recent-packages
commands.summary: Get the site-wide Atom feed of the most recently published package versions on pub.dev.

commands.name: list-package-names
commands.summary: List the names of every package on pub.dev. The output is very large.

commands.name: list-topics
commands.summary: List all package topics with the number of packages tagged with each, as a map of topic to count.

commands.name: list-search-qualifiers
commands.summary: List the search qualifiers (is:, has:, license:, platform:, sdk:, topic:, etc.) and the allowed values for each, for building search-packages queries.

notes: search-packages returns only package names, 10 per page. Use get-package, get-package-score or get-package-metrics to get details for each name.

Search qualifiers can be combined in q, for example 'topic:http platform:web', 'dependency:dio' (packages that depend on dio) or 'publisher:dart.dev'. Use list-search-qualifiers for the valid qualifier values and list-topics for topic names.
The HTML search page (/packages?q=...) is blocked by robots.txt, so always use the JSON search API.
get-package and list-package-versions both call /api/packages/{name}. get-package returns the latest version and list-package-versions returns the full version history.
Package archives can be downloaded from the archive_url field (https://pub.dev/api/archives/{name}-{version}.tar.gz).
Liking a package requires a signed-in Google session. It was not recorded, so it is not exposed.
